end.parentNote: Parth practised keeping track by making one mark for each ball, sheep, or goat. They explained the one-object, one-mark method and used three lines correctly for three goats. They mixed up the count once and noticed that rushing can cause extra marks; this was not fully corrected by the last response. At home, try a short game with buttons or toys: Parth can touch each object once and make one tick for it, then check the two groups together.
